card/clay-pit.subject: two workers in one shallow open pit: one carries a basket of wet ochre clay up the bank, the other prises lumps of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks, from a seam exposed in the pit wall; the clay and the ore both clearly visible as two different materials
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 3.3); no text: the dome's gold pattern is floral sprigs, the parapet and pit walls are plain.
Two large figures read at 120 px: the clay carrier climbing the bank with a basket on his shoulder, and the miner at the seam.

Clay and ore are distinct at shipped size without counting: ochre clay heaps and a full basket on the left, a dark crimson ore seam with blue-grey metallic flecks and fallen lumps on the right (the clay looks dry rather than wet, a minor point).
Clearly a different painting from Duel's clay-pit (a shallow open pit with an ore seam, against Duel's deep shaft with a rope-hauled basket).

Brown accent fits; style, density and figure scale match the anchor and Duel's clay-pool and brickyard; one domed pavilion, no minaret, emblem or animals. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/loom.subject: a weaver seated at a simple upright wooden loom, drawing a shuttle through the warp threads of a broad, half-woven cloth in rose and lapis stripes, a folded bolt of the same striped cloth on a low stool beside the loom
card/loom.promptAmend: Keep the background pavilion plain: its parapet, door panels and steps show only simple geometric tile bands with no lettering, glyphs or script-like marks. Pattern the weaver's robe with small round floral rosettes or leafy sprigs, never fleur-de-lis or lily emblems. Weave the cloth on the loom and the folded bolt in plain broad rose and lapis stripes edged with thin gold pinstripes only: no gold motifs, cartouches, medallions, marks or bands inside the stripes.
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 4.9); the 4:3 crop keeps every element with about 100 px of ivory paper at left and right; the edges feather cleanly; no signature or watermark in the corners.

No text or pseudo-writing at full resolution: the robe has rosettes and gold specks only, no fleurs-de-lis; the bolt and the cloth on the loom are plain rose and lapis stripes with gold pinstripes and nothing inside the stripes; the kiosk's parapet band is diamonds, rosettes and palmettes with no strokes or baseline, tile ornament (checked again at 6x by the integrator).
Reads at 120 px as one large weaver at an upright loom with striped cloth, and a striped bolt on a stool; no crowd.

Grey accent carried by the slate robe and veil, matching Duel's grey cards; line, opaque gouache, lilac rocks and density match the anchor; gold on finials, pinstripes, sash and specks (the gold kiosk dome is a minor excess, small and in the background).

One small domed garden kiosk, no minaret, mosque, emblem or animals; generic period dress. The cloth reads as woven cloth on a loom (white warp above the woven edge, boat shuttle in hand), not a carpet, rug or banner. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/ore-vein.subject: a miner with a short pick prising lumps of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks, from a narrow seam that runs through a pale rock face, and dropping them into a shallow basket at his feet
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 3.5); no text anywhere: the kiosk's base band is leafy vine scrolls, not letter-like.
One large kneeling miner reads at 120 px; the rust-red seam stands out in the pale rock, with the basket of lumps at his feet.
The ore reads as metal ore: rust-red lumps with grey-blue metallic glints, not stone or coal, and stays rust-red at 480 px.
Brown accent fits (brown robe, ochre ground, pastel rocks); gold only on the sun disc and finial; line, gouache and margin match the anchor.
One domed garden kiosk, no minaret, emblem or animals; figure scale and density match Duel's stone-pit and quarry. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.
